stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Moose Knucklers has been laid to rest (15.79 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🗑️ DROP REGRET: Drake Maye averaged 7.5 before 49er Faith-Fool cut him in Week 4. Since: 30.1 a week. Now he's helping Brock You Like a Hurricane.
🏟️ Game to watch: NE @ CHI (Thursday 8:15 PM), 13 league starters in action with 145.18 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (NE @ CHI): 13 league starters, led by Brock You Like a Hurricane vs Mr. Action Jackson.
🔁 In hindsight: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Mel's Mediocre Mob leads the chopping-block odds at 37%, with In My Fantasy Era next at 36%.
🔭 Player to watch: A.J. Brown (NE @ CHI). ESPN projects 16.25 pts, and Ruffing the Passer is 56% against Gibb it to Me Baby.
🎸 DEEP CUTS: Ramosverse is starting Hutchinson (3%) and McLaughlin (22%) while Washington (95%) and Nix (61%) sit. % = rostered across ESPN.
🤝 Rivalry week: Claremont In Yo Stace! leads TDsMaGee 6–2 all-time, and Claremont In Yo Stace! has won the last 3.
🪑 Bench of broken dreams: Kirbo Crushers has started Khalil Shakir just once. Starting him in Weeks 1, 4, 5 and 6 would have meant 2 more wins by now.
🏆 Title odds entering Week 7: Brock You Like a Hurricane 33%, Gibb it to Me Baby 24%, Claremont In Yo Stace! 12%.
📈 TRENDING: Konata Mumpfield (WR, LAR) is one of the most-added players in fantasy over the past 24 hours. Nobody here has him.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 19% against Claremont In Yo Stace! — and won.
